- Use line breaks between every sentence or two. Wall-of-text kills engagement.
- 3-5 specific takeaways from the post. Name actual tool names, real workflow steps, real numbers. NO vague advice.

- No emoji spam. One or two MAX, only if they earn their place. No 🚀.
- No hashtags except 1-2 highly specific ones at the very end (e.g. #RevOps, #GTM). Skip generic ones.

Avoid these LinkedIn cliches: "hot take", "unpopular opinion", "here's the thing", emoji bullet points, "thoughts?", "agree?", numbered lists with one word per number.

Output ONLY the LinkedIn post text. No commentary. No explanation.

BLOG POST:
${$('Carry PR Info').first().json.markdown}` }] }) }}
